I replied to Hollis in a thread in #central-team: the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 382 seats.

That figure comes from Tobias, who posted it in #central-team on Oct 14. Hollis is a member of that channel, so sharing it there was fine. Nothing posted in the channel since then changes it. I couldn't find any Marrow Agrisupply files in the shared drive to check it against, so I suggested Hollis quickly confirm with Tobias before locking in the account sheet.
